test_basis: Approved accepted.md and proposed existing-issue-contract-v1.json; proposed restrictions await lead review.
common_setup: Disposable per-case SQLite/authority/provider stores; actual Core and service; loopback HTTP provider returning authored schema-compatible data; actual current Technical Writer for writing controls; no live credentials, provider or models. Canonical issue, principal, workspace, team and project are distinct UUIDs. Initial valid history is Backlog from creation, then optional Todo, with unchanged classified state metadata.
no_effect_oracle: Compare domain tasks, bindings, operations, events, outbox, attempts, capacity reservations and resource leases before/after; inspect loopback requests for zero provider mutations. Expiring source observations or positive lifecycle fences are permitted only where the case explicitly expects them. Never equate a false/checked output flag with no effect.

case_objects.precondition: An authorized own candidate exists after two search pages.
case_objects.actions: Call task_find with a title query; follow returned cursor.
case_objects.expected: Only exact own candidates and actual identifiers are returned; each page is correctly bounded; no domain or provider mutation.

case_objects.precondition: Provider filter incorrectly returns a different assignee with sentinel private title/body.
case_objects.actions: Call task_find.
case_objects.expected: Foreign candidate is excluded before a title/body query; sentinel absent from result, errors, receipt store and logs; no domain effect.

case_objects.precondition: Responses contain wrong workspace, team or project independently.
case_objects.actions: Run each scope variant through task_find and task_inspect.
case_objects.expected: Scope is denied before foreign prose fetch/storage; no candidate receipt or task.

case_objects.precondition: Metadata is authorized but assignee/team/project changes on the prose response.
case_objects.actions: Call task_inspect with each change.
case_objects.expected: No prose leaves the adapter or enters durable observations/diagnostics; no admissible receipt or task.

case_objects.precondition: Provider resolves an actual display identifier to canonical UUID.
case_objects.actions: Inspect by display identifier, then admit the returned receipt after approval.
case_objects.expected: All claims use returned canonical UUID; display text cannot redirect mutation or synthesize an issue number.

case_objects.precondition: Two scoped issues share a title and a foreign issue matches it too.
case_objects.actions: Search, inspect one explicit canonical selection, admit it.
case_objects.expected: No title-based implicit selection or duplicate create; only the selected exact canonical issue is bound.

case_objects.precondition: Provider returns HTTP 200 with GraphQL errors containing private sentinels and partial data.
case_objects.actions: Call search and inspect separately.
case_objects.expected: Sanitized failure, no partial eligible result, no private sentinel in durable/output diagnostics, no domain effect.

case_objects.precondition: Duplicate node IDs, repeating/missing cursor or declared additional page exceeds bounds.
case_objects.actions: Exercise actual pagination reader with each malformed chain.
case_objects.expected: No incomplete history or candidate set is treated as complete; admission remains blocked.

case_objects.precondition: Exact issue is absent, archived, trashed or identifier has controls/invalid form.
case_objects.actions: Inspect each variant.
case_objects.expected: Bounded sanitized denial/blocker; archived/trashed work is not newly admitted; malformed identifier never becomes query authority.

case_objects.precondition: Synthetic 401/403/429, transport timeout and credential binding change.
case_objects.actions: Call actual reader for each failure.
case_objects.expected: Existing truthful error categories, zero create/update calls and no new task/worker; timeout does not trigger a create fallback.

case_objects.precondition: Complete stable initial Backlog-only timeline covers issue creation.
case_objects.actions: Inspect and evaluate actual normalized history.
case_objects.expected: Initial Backlog confirmed; eligible for local binding only, never implicitly queued or running.

case_objects.precondition: Complete stable Backlog then Todo timeline.
case_objects.actions: Inspect, approve, select and admit.
case_objects.expected: Observed Todo is preserved, queued_once=false, no remote write or attempt.

case_objects.precondition: Activity history is empty/current Backlog but state timeline starts after creation.
case_objects.actions: Inspect and attempt admission.
case_objects.expected: Missing prefix is blocked; activity absence does not prove initial Backlog or never-delivered.

case_objects.precondition: A span gap, overlap, duplicate ID, multiple open spans or last-state mismatch.
case_objects.actions: Evaluate each malformed complete-looking response and attempt admission.
case_objects.expected: Typed history blocker, no local task or provider effect.

case_objects.precondition: Earliest confirmed span starts in Todo or In Progress rather than Backlog.
case_objects.actions: Inspect and attempt admission.
case_objects.expected: No synthetic Backlog reset/history; task remains unbound.

case_objects.precondition: Historic state is null/deleted/unknown or was edited after its relevant span.
case_objects.actions: Inspect each attribution variant and attempt admission.
case_objects.expected: Cannot conclude never-delivered; historical classification ambiguity is blocked.

case_objects.precondition: Timeline contains In Dev, In Staging or Done and current remote status is Todo/Backlog.
case_objects.actions: Inspect, then attempt admission for each delivery stage.
case_objects.expected: Canonical delivery fence retained, no task/worker/create; report linked-followup dependency without reopening.

case_objects.precondition: Earlier local bound-task delivery proof exists; later remote history omits or renames that state.
case_objects.actions: Reinspect and attempt a new claim/queue.
case_objects.expected: Local monotone fence wins; no reset by mutable provider names or newer Backlog.

case_objects.precondition: More than one provider history page and a revision change during pagination.
case_objects.actions: Inspect with the race between pages and final metadata.
case_objects.expected: No mixed-version eligible receipt; retry requires fresh inspection, with no task or mutation.

case_objects.precondition: Current or historical unbound In Progress/On Hold/In Review has unknown ownership or prior session admission.
case_objects.actions: Inspect and attempt new admission.
case_objects.expected: Readable own issue and explicit guarded blocker; no invented quiescence, queue history, human acceptance or competing worker.

case_objects.precondition: Actual current task-purpose finalized Writer result matches exact scoped issue prose and semantic metadata.
case_objects.actions: Admit using its real approval reference and observed selection receipt.
case_objects.expected: Core accepts exact provider-supported prose; TST-83 handoff remains actual source metadata; no fabricated public summary or human proof.

case_objects.precondition: Missing, malformed or caller-invented writing reference.
case_objects.actions: Call task_admit for each variant.
case_objects.expected: Typed refusal before task/binding/outbox/attempt/provider effects.

case_objects.precondition: Real approval is for progress, another session or another principal/project.
case_objects.actions: Call public admission and direct Core admission for each variant.
case_objects.expected: Purpose/scope checked inside the actual admission boundary; no cross-scope approval reuse.

case_objects.precondition: Title/body byte change including trailing newline, representation or semantic metadata mismatch.
case_objects.actions: Admit with each changed exact-prose binding.
case_objects.expected: Actual current approval mismatch denies; no rewriting or broad normalization to force a match.

case_objects.precondition: Writer artifact was altered/removed or active policy changed before a NEW admission operation.
case_objects.actions: Attempt fresh-key admission for each change.
case_objects.expected: Current writer verification refuses before any new domain/provider/worker effect.

case_objects.precondition: No selection_ref, forged ref, expired receipt or a valid receipt from another issue/discovery digest/scope.
case_objects.actions: Call service and Core admission for each variant.
case_objects.expected: Selection cannot be supplied by caller booleans or generic grant; no new task/binding.

case_objects.precondition: Default rejecting host selection observer is configured.
case_objects.actions: Try to obtain an existing-issue selection receipt through its actual trusted adapter.
case_objects.expected: Explicit unavailable/refused integration; no synthetic actual-user receipt or admission.

case_objects.precondition: Actual trusted selection adapter receives a synthetic, source-bound selection observation.
case_objects.actions: Issue a signed scoped selection proof, then admit matching issue.
case_objects.expected: Mechanical source/scope/digest/expiry checks execute; evidence labels remain synthetic, not live human or host acceptance.

case_objects.precondition: Same session already owns exact canonical issue with matching current prose.
case_objects.actions: Inspect and admit again with a new operation key.
case_objects.expected: Same Task ID and original history/queue/hold/attempt/resources are reused; no second task or provider mutation.

case_objects.precondition: Same own canonical binding has an active actual attempt.
case_objects.actions: Inspect/admit reuse and attempt an additional worker_start.
case_objects.expected: Current owned attempt is surfaced, no requeue/reset or second active attempt; existing execution guards refuse duplicate start.

case_objects.precondition: Another session/principal/project already owns canonical issue in the shared database.
case_objects.actions: Attempt admission from another registered session after provider reassignment.
case_objects.expected: One retained canonical owner; generic blocker without foreign Task/session/prose; old attempts/resources/audit retained.

case_objects.precondition: Own binding is held or In Review with retained actual history.
case_objects.actions: Inspect/reuse and attempt an agent-only release/queue/start.
case_objects.expected: Existing human decision and guarded path remain; binding reuse cannot manufacture acceptance or release.

case_objects.precondition: Bound issue leaves assignee/team/project after inspection.
case_objects.actions: Perform imported queue/start fresh checks and then current list/show/replay.
case_objects.expected: No foreign prose query; metadata-only fencing/quarantine, no work permission; tombstone rather than old active title/status; no resource release.

case_objects.precondition: Own issue prose changes after its established binding.
case_objects.actions: Try a new admission against changed reviewed/unreviewed text.
case_objects.expected: No silent overwrite/reset; existing staged review/reconciliation route required.

case_objects.precondition: A new imported Backlog task is locally bound but not queued.
case_objects.actions: Call worker_start before enqueue.
case_objects.expected: No reservation, resource or host effect; missing explicit queue admission is refused.

case_objects.precondition: Imported Backlog, actual enqueue authority, stable fresh source.
case_objects.actions: Use unchanged task_action enqueue and exact provider readback.
case_objects.expected: Existing Todo outbox path is used once; queued_once becomes true only after exact confirmed Todo.

case_objects.precondition: Imported confirmed remote Todo but queued_once=false.
case_objects.actions: Call unchanged task_action enqueue with actual authorization and fresh source.
case_objects.expected: Local session membership becomes true with one queue event and zero redundant provider updates; no worker is launched.

case_objects.precondition: Same remote Todo import without valid enqueue authority or fresh source proof.
case_objects.actions: Call direct Core same-status transition and public enqueue negatives.
case_objects.expected: No self-transition bypass: queued_once stays false; no attempt/resource/provider effect.

case_objects.precondition: Imported task is queued but provider status/prose/owner/history changes before startup.
case_objects.actions: Call worker_start against each fresh mismatch.
case_objects.expected: Work remains fenced before reservation/host dispatch; no silent remote overwrite or claimed running worker.

case_objects.precondition: Imported task has valid explicit queue and fresh source but missing actual host startup/resources/In Progress confirmation.
case_objects.actions: Exercise reserve/start/running omissions through actual core/runtime interfaces.
case_objects.expected: Existing gates remain; no executable lease from remote Todo or a generic waiting subprocess.

case_objects.precondition: Remote delivered observation occurs, followed by a newer Todo observation before settlement.
case_objects.actions: Observe both, then attempt reserve/start/lease.
case_objects.expected: Positive canonical/task delivery fence cannot be lost through supersession or settlement ordering; no further work.

case_objects.precondition: Two threads/sessions compete for the same canonical issue and share Core database.
case_objects.actions: Synchronize concurrent admission at the transactional claim boundary.
case_objects.expected: Exactly one canonical task/owner, other request is safely blocked, no orphan tasks/provider write.

case_objects.precondition: Two independent OS processes use the same owned Core database.
case_objects.actions: Synchronize competing different-session admissions.
case_objects.expected: SQLite uniqueness and transaction enforce one claim; no second owner, leaked partial task or orphan event.

case_objects.precondition: Same session admits same issue concurrently with different operation keys.
case_objects.actions: Run both admissions at once.
case_objects.expected: Both settle on the same Task ID; only one task/binding/admission event is created.

case_objects.precondition: Provider changes revision/state/prose/owner after history read but before final metadata check.
case_objects.actions: Inject each change at the final-read boundary.
case_objects.expected: No new task or queue; detectable stale source cannot commit an eligible binding.

case_objects.precondition: Human hold/current decision advances after source read but before own-binding queue commit.
case_objects.actions: Race the actual decision record with enqueue transaction.
case_objects.expected: Stale version/revision refuses; newest hold wins, no stale queue or worker.

case_objects.precondition: Existing own task has active/unresolved resources while another claim is attempted.
case_objects.actions: Reassign provider issue and admit from another session; retry after hiding old task.
case_objects.expected: Visibility or reassignment does not release ownership/resources; explicit reconciliation is still required.

case_objects.precondition: Crash before local transaction commit.
case_objects.actions: Fault admission after Task insert but before commit; reopen store and retry.
case_objects.expected: Rollback leaves no partial task/binding/event/operation; one later successful admission, no remote mutation.

case_objects.precondition: Core commit succeeds but service reply/invocation finish is lost.
case_objects.actions: Restart a process and retry same public operation key after Writer cleanup or policy change.
case_objects.expected: Recover original committed operation before new authority consumption, return current scoped TaskView, no second task/proof/provider effect.

case_objects.precondition: A committed public operation key is reused with changed discovery/writing/selection inputs or another session.
case_objects.actions: Replay each mismatch.
case_objects.expected: Idempotency/scope conflict, no altered binding or leaked cached prose.

case_objects.precondition: Task admitted, later quarantined, then committed admission retry occurs.
case_objects.actions: Retry the original successful key.
case_objects.expected: Current tombstone projection only; no foreign current or cached original prose/status presented as active.

case_objects.precondition: Inspection receipt expired or changed before any commit.
case_objects.actions: Attempt admission and same-key retry without a committed result.
case_objects.expected: No task or remote create; require new inspection/selection as appropriate rather than treating an unsuccessful attempt as committed.

case_objects.precondition: Existing schema version 2 with bound delivered and non-delivered tasks, sessions and active resources.
case_objects.actions: Open migrated database and read prior records; attempt conflicting delivery admission.
case_objects.expected: Backward-compatible records and resource ownership retained; delivered flags seed monotone canonical fences; no guessed negative history.

case_objects.precondition: Foreign/future storage schema or malformed canonical lifecycle record.
case_objects.actions: Open/use admission.
case_objects.expected: Typed schema refusal and no destructive repair or reset.

case_objects.precondition: Actual current Writer plus authored loopback provider and signed synthetic selection.
case_objects.actions: Execute writing prepare/review/finalize, inspect, admit, enqueue and task_show through actual ApplicationService.
case_objects.expected: Exact content/Scope and step effects verified; real handoff bytes retained, no remote issue create, no early worker claim.

case_objects.precondition: Each required admission argument omitted or unknown self-authority fields supplied.
case_objects.actions: Call public schema with each omission and booleans/unknown fields.
case_objects.expected: Actual schema refusal with no provider/domain/runtime mutation; caller cannot mint authority.

case_objects.precondition: Valid prose approval but sequence skips inspect or explicit selection.
case_objects.actions: Perform actual reordered/omitted calls, not case-label lookups.
case_objects.expected: No task binding, implicit discovery, duplicate create or queue permission.

case_objects.precondition: Only inspect/admit has occurred; no authorized queue.
case_objects.actions: Try worker_start before queue, then queue before missing fresh-source/authority controls.
case_objects.expected: Concrete attempts/resources/outbox remain unchanged on each unauthorized boundary; permitted reads remain available.

case_objects.precondition: Isolated built/installed wheel, actual CLI config, authored loopback provider and preissued synthetic selection.
case_objects.actions: Execute aitm task find/inspect/admit and current task show with JSON inputs.
case_objects.expected: Installed entry point implements exact schemas, exit/envelope facts and canonical binding; no normal-session installation or live account.

case_objects.precondition: Installed CLI, foreign sentinel candidate plus malformed/expired authority.
case_objects.actions: Execute lookup and negative admission through a subprocess.
case_objects.expected: Actual stderr/exit category and no-effect assertions; no private output/logs and no issue-create fallback.

case_objects.precondition: Actual MCP SDK ClientSession over stdio to installed product with authored loopback fixtures.
case_objects.actions: List tools and call task_find/task_inspect/task_admit with preissued synthetic selection.
case_objects.expected: Exact additive tools/input schemas and actual scoped binding result; stdio protocol carries no raw review/authority keys.

case_objects.precondition: Same actual stdio boundary with foreign/stale/cross-session refs and unknown operations.
case_objects.actions: Call each actual negative tool boundary.
case_objects.expected: Typed sanitized refusal/no new task/provider mutation, other session cannot consume or observe cached binding.

case_objects.precondition: Existing new-task create, status transitions, holds/review, explicit queue, worker lifecycle and provider-outbox fixtures.
case_objects.actions: Run the directly impacted existing regression modules unchanged, except additive schema count/fingerprint.
case_objects.expected: Protected commands/inputs/delivery flow and evidence gates retain their behavior; no copied alternative policy table.

case_objects.precondition: Focused mechanical candidate is complete.
case_objects.actions: Inspect test result/artifact manifest, actual source hashes and missing integrations.
case_objects.expected: Authored provider/synthetic selection/protocol passes are separated from live Linear history/real host selection/model acceptance, which remain not_run. No release/readiness claim from fixture passes.

case_objects.precondition: An installation enrolls one Core claim store; a second independent unshared store has its own valid schema/session but is not enrolled.
case_objects.actions: Point a separately sealed product configuration at the second store and call load_service/admission.
case_objects.expected: Product composition rejects the unenrolled/mismatched store before task effects. Shared-store processes still compose. Direct isolated Core fixtures do not imply a cross-installation distributed lock.

case_objects.precondition: An enrolled store is copied/replaced at the same pathname, preserving its internal UUID but changing actual file identity, or the signed enrollment is changed.
case_objects.actions: Load the product and invoke a previously composed service after replacement/tamper.
case_objects.expected: No pathname-only or UUID-only acceptance; refuse before new effects, preserve original ownership/audit and require explicit trusted recovery.

case_objects.precondition: An enrolled owned file is renamed without changing its store UUID/file identity; a separate replacement has no trusted quiescence/recovery record.
case_objects.actions: Update the sealed configuration to the renamed same file and compose; then attempt automatic re-enrollment of the replacement.
case_objects.expected: Stable enrolled identity survives an explicitly configured same-file rename; replacement never auto-enrolls or clears claims/resources.

case_objects.precondition: Valid discovery/selection/admission invocation records from one enrolled installation/store exist.
case_objects.actions: Try them in a different enrolled installation/store using otherwise identical Scope and operation key.
case_objects.expected: Installation/store context prevents receipt or cache reuse; no foreign cached content, competing task or provider mutation. Separate installations remain outside a distributed Linear claim guarantee.

cleanup: Each case closes its loopback HTTP thread, child process, SQLite connections and owned temporary store; process/race cases join every child. Retain failed logs and artifact hashes under ignored local evidence; do not remove unexplained resources as if stopped.
